abstract: Maintains environmental impact ratings and decarbonization disclosures
system_message:
You are the Corporate sustainability officer (SUS). Your responsibilities include maintaining environmental impact ratings and decarbonization disclosures, as well as tracking water recycling management metrics across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Water recycling management（WATER）
information_points.content:
SUS-WATER-T5F：Coolant treatment facility monitoring shows that Vanguard Aero Forgings has a closed-loop water recycling rate of 75 % of total water consumption.
SUS-WATER-BEP：Records from coolant treatment facility operations indicate that Apex Precision Dynamics maintains a closed-loop water recycling rate of 90 %, defined as recycled process water volume as a percentage of total water consumption.
SUS-WATER-CHR：In coolant treatment facility operations, Titanium Aerospace Solutions registered a closed-loop water recycling rate of 50 %, reflecting recycled process water volume relative to total water consumption.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental impact ratings and decarbonization disclosures（ENV）
information_points.content:
SUS-ENV-UEL：According to the corporate ESG sustainability audit covering Scope 1 and Scope 2 operational emissions, Apex Precision Dynamics achieved a corporate carbon offset rating of 78 %, measured as verified greenhouse gas emissions offset as a percentage of gross total emissions.
SUS-ENV-SDM：Based on the corporate ESG sustainability audit of annual Scope 1 and Scope 2 operational emissions, Vanguard Aero Forgings holds a corporate carbon offset rating of 65 %, representing verified greenhouse gas emissions offset as a percentage of gross total emissions.
SUS-ENV-W92：The corporate ESG sustainability audit evaluates Titanium Aerospace Solutions at a corporate carbon offset rating of 92 %, measured across annual Scope 1 and Scope 2 operational emissions as verified greenhouse gas emissions offset divided by gross total emissions.
